SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: A ______ can alter activity in the ______, changing how strongly a person notices a signal.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Sustained ______ improves ______ because information is processed deeply enough to be stored.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 持续注意会改善记忆，因为信息被处理得足够深入以便储存。
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Sustained attention improves memory because information is processed deeply enough to be stored.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Repeated ______ can strengthen neural ______ when recalling information reshapes the connections used for learning.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 反复提取会增强神经可塑性，因为回忆信息会重塑学习所用连接。
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Repeated retrieval can strengthen neural plasticity when recalling information reshapes the connections used for learning.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Brain ______ explains why some functions rely more on one hemisphere, while ______ control helps suppress irrelevant responses.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 大脑侧化解释为什么某些功能更依赖一个半球，而执行控制帮助抑制无关反应。

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: An ______ can record brainwaves, but ______ analysis is needed to connect signals with actual mental tasks.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Excessive ______ can increase runoff, while repeated ______ use may create resistant weeds.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: A healthy ______ depends on fertile ______, because roots need water, minerals, and stable structure.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Child ______ can persist even when calorie intake is adequate, if each essential ______ remains missing.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: ______ food may spoil quickly unless safe ______ methods slow bacterial growth.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Urban zoning separates ______, ______, and ______ areas so noise, housing, and jobs can be managed.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Urban zoning separates residential, commercial, and industrial areas so noise, housing, and jobs can be managed.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Higher ______ can support public ______ because more passengers live close to each station.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Higher density can support public transportation because more passengers live close to each station.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Urban ______ may cause displacement unless ______ also protects existing residents and small businesses.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Urban redevelopment may cause displacement unless revitalization also protects existing residents and small businesses.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: A new ______ can change the city ______ when its height makes it visible from every district.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: A weak ______ can make a ______ wall dangerous because the structure cannot transfer weight safely.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: A weak foundation can make a load-bearing wall dangerous because the structure cannot transfer weight safely.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Physical oceanography studies how an ocean current transports heat, salt, and nutrients across regions.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: Coastal ______ brings nutrients upward, which can increase ______ growth and support fish populations.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 沿岸上升流把营养物带到上层，从而增加浮游植物生长并支持鱼类种群。
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: Coastal upwelling brings nutrients upward, which can increase phytoplankton growth and support fish populations.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: ______ circulation affects deep-water movement, which helps regulate long-term ______ storage in the ocean.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 温盐环流影响深层水运动，从而帮助调节海洋中的长期碳储存。
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: thermohaline circulation affects deep-water movement, which helps regulate long-term carbon storage in the ocean.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: A burial ritual can preserve ancestral memory by turning family history into repeated public practice.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: A collective response becomes adaptive when shared rules help the whole group survive environmental pressure.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: An evolutionary account of human history should include genetic evidence, but culture can change faster than genes.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.blank_sentence: A sudden ______ movement can reshape a local ______ by bringing new languages, tools, and marriage patterns.
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.sentence_zh: 突然的人口迁移会通过带来新语言、工具和婚姻模式重塑本地人口。
SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: A sudden migration movement can reshape a local population by bringing new languages, tools, and marriage patterns.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: intergroup contact can reduce hostility when shared symbolic practices give rival groups a common story.

SCENE_BLANK_QUESTIONS.full_sentence: cognitive change matters because cultural tools, stories, and rituals expand what humans can remember together.
